cues.text: From the rocks, you watch a girl in a long dress stand alone at the end of a pier.
Junpei walks out along the pier to the girl.
Junpei freezes, then trudges back, head hung.
Akihiko pats your head, then walks out along the pier.
You walk out along the pier to the girl, while Junpei and Akihiko watch.
You speak quietly; she turns to face you.
She dashes past you and runs off; Junpei and Akihiko join you.
